status.description:
Cache cluster status. Valid values:
● NEW: Newly created and not started.
● STARTING: Starting.
● START\_FAILED: Start failed.
● RUNNING: Running.
● PENDING\_RESTART: Pending restart.
● PENDING\_TERMINATE: Pending termination.
● TERMINATING: Terminating.
● TERMINATE\_FAILED: Termination failed.
● TERMINATED: Terminated.
